subject: Post-call: Compliance sprint kickoff — retention, pen-test scope, SOC 2 evidence
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Patricia Gomez <pgomez@valuenest.com>, Kenji Saito <ksaito@valuenest.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, irene.choi@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-12-03T10:15:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call: Compliance sprint kickoff — retention, pen-test scope, SOC 2 evidence

Hi Patricia / Kenji —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we’re aligned heading into a short compliance sprint: we captured the key pain points and your goals, and I’ve mapped owners on our side below.

What we heard (high level):
- Primary requirement: 12-month retention for user-facing audit logs; 7-year retention for transaction records (per your legal team) — need to confirm which logs fall into which bucket.
- SOC 2 is a gating item for procurement (deadline end of Q1). You asked for a short evidence pack we can hand to auditors (system description, control mapping, TLS/KMS details, recent penetration test results or plan).
- Pen test: ValueNest prefers vendor-to-vendor coordination. You want a scope draft + target window (Jan 20–31 suggested) and confirmation we’ll produce remediation timelines for any findings.
- DPA: you requested our tracked DPA draft with e-sign and a change log showing where Redwoods defaults differ.

Immediate next steps (proposed):
1) Redwood: send SOC 2 summary + artifact index (attachment) — owner: Mina — by EOD today.
2) ValueNest: confirm retention mapping (which logs are transactional vs. activity) and share compliance contact for legal team — owner: Patricia — by Wed 12/10.
3) Pen test scope: Redwood to propose scope doc (attachment) and preferred test vendor handoff instructions — owner: Rishi — by Tue 12/9.
4) DPA redline: Redwood to share tracked DPA and highlight encryption/KMS and hosting clauses — owner: Irene — by Fri 12/12.

Attachments included: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (summary, control mapping), pen_test_scope_valuenest.pdf (draft scope), dpa-draft-valuenest.docx (tracked DPA).

Please let me know any corrections to the summary; if this looks right, Patricia, can you confirm who in ValueNest will own the legal side so we can include them on the DPA thread?

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment stubs: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (PDF, 42KB) — includes SOC 2 control mapping, snapshot of last audit date, list of common artifacts we can produce.
From: Patricia Gomez <pgomez@valuenest.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kenji Saito <ksaito@valuenest.com>, ops@valuenest.com
Date: 2025-12-03T13:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Compliance sprint kickoff — retention, pen-test scope, SOC 2 evidence

Thanks Mina — appreciate the clear recap. Couple clarifications from our side:

1) Retention mapping: our legal team says transaction records (settlement logs, payment confirmations) need 7-year retention; audit trails (user actions, admin changes) can be 12 months. We will validate whether some aggregated access logs can be kept 12 months instead of 7.

2) Pen test: we prefer Redwood run the pen-test with our vendor present (no shared credentials provided to external parties). Can you confirm if Redwood supports a vendor-to-vendor handoff where we sign an NDA and grant limited test accounts? Also want to see a sample scope with OWASP + infrastructure checks included.

3) SOC2 evidence: our auditors will want a short bundle with the system description, last audit cover letter (if applicable), data flow diagrams for PII, and the control matrix. The redwood-soc2-summary.pdf looks like a good start — thanks.

I’ll pull in our legal contact (Lauren Meyer) on the DPA thread — copying Kenji and ops for the operational asks. I’ll aim to have the retention mapping and Lauren’s details by COB Tuesday 12/9.

Patricia
Patricia Gomez
Head of Compliance, ValueNest
pgomez@valuenest.com
+1 (617) 555-0999

Subject: Fwd: Post-call: Compliance sprint kickoff — retention, pen-test scope, SOC 2 evidence

Internal note / action items from ValueNest call — forwarding for visibility.

Rishi / Irene — short asks (please respond inline so I can update Patricia):

- Rishi: can you draft the pen test scope that includes OWASP Top 10, internal network scans, and a short section on our remediation SLAs (suggested 30/60/90 day buckets)? Also include recommended dates — Patricia suggested Jan 20–31. Please attach a short vendor-handoff checklist (NDA, test accounts, and allowed IP ranges).

- Irene: please prepare a DPA redline that highlights hosting, encryption at rest, KMS key custody options, and log retention language. We should call out default retention and provide samples for 12-month and 7-year options.

I’ll keep Patricia cc’d on replies so we move quickly. Goal: get scope + DPA to them by next week so legal can review before end-Q1 procurement.

Thanks — Mina

Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call: Compliance sprint kickoff — retention, pen-test scope, SOC 2 evidence

Thanks Mina — I’ll get a pen test scope draft and the vendor handoff checklist over by end of day tomorrow (12/05). Key notes I’ll include:

- Scope: external blackbox + authenticated app-layer tests (OWASP Top 10), internal network surface if ValueNest opts into host-level scans, basic infra checks (exposed S3, misconfigured IAM, RCE checks for components we expose to their systems).
- Credentials: default approach is vendor-to-vendor NDA + limited test accounts; no production DB dumps.
- Remediation SLA proposals: Critical (7 days to acknowledge, 30 days TTR), High (14 days ack, 60 days TTR), Medium (30 days ack, 90 days TTR).
- Evidence deliverables: final report (PDF), triage sheet (CSV), remediation plan (doc).

Irene — will sync on any DPA-specific items that affect the scope (e.g., if certain logs cannot be accessed for testing due to retention constraints).

Rishi
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
